title: Syria denies it’s joining war in Yemen
gist: A short Al-Monitor 'Middle East Minute' podcast episode reporting that Syria denies joining the war in Yemen, that the US is providing intelligence support to Saudi Arabia, and that oil flows in the Middle East are recovering.

insights.claim: Syria has denied that it is joining the war in Yemen, according to an Al-Monitor Middle East Minute podcast episode.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Limits fears of the Yemen conflict widening to additional state belligerents.
insights.quote: Syria denies it’s joining war in Yemen

insights.claim: The United States is providing intelligence support to Saudi Arabia amid the war in Yemen.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Indirect US involvement deepens great-power stakes in the Saudi-Houthi conflict and Red Sea security.
insights.quote: The US is providing intelligence support to Saudi Arabia

insights.claim: Oil flows in the Middle East are recovering, according to Al-Monitor's Middle East Minute podcast.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Recovering regional oil flows ease supply-disruption risk premia in crude prices.
insights.quote: oil flows in the Middle East are recovering
